responsibility: GNU Modula-2 driver-specific spec processing and argument rewriting layer used by the gm2 executable. It scans decoded GCC driver options, recognizes Modula-2 source files and dialect/library selections, synthesizes extra cc1gm2 and linker options, manages library search/path grouping, scaffold and module-list options, plugin enablement, and default linkage against gm2 runtime, C++ standard, math, and pthread libraries, making it the file that turns user-facing gm2 invocations into the final GCC driver command sequence.
